claim_being_audited: That the model should be certified for deployment now, based on current evidence, because aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, with the strongest defensible case being a disclosed-risk launch rather than a no-caveat certification.
decision_criteria: Under the policy, certification without material caveats requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation meeting the stated fields.
If certification is intended as a disclosed-risk launch, admissible evidence must show the required limitation disclosure is actually in place.
Aggregate readiness pass and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient to erase a current named-use-case weakness.
Draft runbooks and future monitoring support risk management but do not by themselves satisfy the policy exception.
evidence_requests: Current approved model card or release artifact showing the limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record containing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Finalized runbook version showing complete governance fields and activation criteria.
Release decision record clarifying whether certification is caveated/disclosed-risk or unconditional.
specific_concerns: The admissible record, as summarized, still shows a material named-use-case weakness in health-plan benefits support.
The mitigation runbook is described as a draft and missing governance fields such as owner and customer-notice criterion.
Policy text says draft monitoring artifacts do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved.
No admissible evidence in the record shows that the model card limitation disclosure has actually been completed.
No admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation or risk acceptance satisfying the policy predicate for certification without material caveats.
The recommended action is stated as `certify_model`, but the supporting rationale only defends a caveated, disclosed-risk launch.
unsupported_claims: Any no-caveat certification claim is unsupported on the summarized record.
Any claim that current monitoring and rollback plans alone satisfy the policy threshold is unsupported without approval evidence.
Any claim that the current draft mitigation package removes the disclosure requirement is unsupported.
